source.name: Lexique
source.citation: New, B., Pallier, C., Brysbaert, M., Ferrand, L. (2004). Lexique 2: A new French lexical database. Behavior Research Methods, Instruments, & Computers, 36(3), 516-524.

frequency_column: freqlemfilms2 (lemma frequency in film subtitles, occurrences per million); nouns are ordered by it descending, ties alphabetical
gender_rule: m/f if all gendered Lexique rows of the lemma agree; mf if both genders occur or Lexique leaves gender blank (epicene or meaning-dependent, e.g. élève, livre, tour)
